title: Noise-preprocessed check value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $C$ be a check consisting of a sign-valued predicate and a cube query at each predicate input, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$. Independently noise each query using the noise kernel with parameter $1-\delta$, then take the expected randomized value of the predicate when its inputs are the values of $f$ on the resulting noisy queries.
caveat: The exact meaning of the predicate's randomized value is not defined in the supplied snippet.
